description: This file defines structures and a registry for displaying tool information, including summaries, configuration loading, and utility functions for processing tool data within the OpenClawKit project.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summary of a tool display, including methods for generating display lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: An enum managing the configuration and resolution of tool display information, including loading config and generating summaries.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a tool display summary based on the tool name, arguments, and optional metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration from a JSON resource file.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default configuration for tool display if loading from resource fails.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a tool name.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Generates a detail string for read operations, including optional offset and limit.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Retrieves the path detail from arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Finds the first non-empty rendered value from a list of keys in arguments.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value into a string, handling various data types.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from arguments based on a key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path with '~' in a string.
